--!strict
-- Pure logic of Rolling Ball's modules, in an empty scene.
local Clock = require("../Scripts/Clock")
local Motion = require("../Scripts/Motion")
local Track = require("../Scripts/Track")

return Test.Suite("Logic", function()
	Test.Case("Clock: formats whole ticks as M:SS.t", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Clock.Format(0), "0:00.0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Clock.Format(59), "0:00.9")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Clock.Format(60), "0:01.0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Clock.Format(3600), "1:00.0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Clock.Format(36000), "10:00.0")
	end)

	Test.Case("Motion: Ease dwells, rises, dwells and returns, and Dwell tells the dwell and the ticks it has left", function()
		-- MoveTicks 180 and DwellTicks 120: a period of 600 ticks.
		Test.ExpectEqual(Motion.Ease(0, 180, 120), 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Motion.Ease(119, 180, 120), 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Motion.Ease(120, 180, 120), 0)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Ease(210, 180, 120), 0.5, 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Motion.Ease(300, 180, 120), 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Motion.Ease(419, 180, 120), 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Motion.Ease(420, 180, 120), 1)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Ease(510, 180, 120), 0.5, 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Ease(599, 180, 120), 0, 0.001)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Motion.Ease(600, 180, 120), 0)
		local atStart, atEnd, left = Motion.Dwell(20, 180, 120)
		Test.Expect(atStart and not atEnd, "tick 20 dwells at the start")
		Test.ExpectEqual(left, 100)
		atStart, atEnd, left = Motion.Dwell(200, 180, 120)
		Test.Expect(not atStart and not atEnd, "tick 200 moves")
		Test.ExpectEqual(left, 0)
		atStart, atEnd, left = Motion.Dwell(310, 180, 120)
		Test.Expect(atEnd and not atStart, "tick 310 dwells at the end")
		Test.ExpectEqual(left, 110)
	end)

	Test.Case("Motion: headings face their direction and turn by at most a step", function()
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.HeadingOf(vector.create(0, 0, -1)), 0, 0.0001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.HeadingOf(vector.create(-1, 0, 0)), 90, 0.0001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.HeadingOf(vector.create(1, 0, 0)), -90, 0.0001)
		Test.ExpectNear(math.abs(Motion.HeadingOf(vector.create(0, 0, 1))), 180, 0.0001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Forward(0), vector.create(0, 0, -1), 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Forward(90), vector.create(-1, 0, 0), 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Right(0), vector.create(1, 0, 0), 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Right(90), vector.create(0, 0, -1), 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Turn(0, 90, 2), 2, 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Turn(0, -90, 2), -2, 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Turn(10, 12, 5), 12, 0.000001)
		-- A turn wraps at +-180 degrees.
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Turn(179, -179, 5), -179, 0.00001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Turn(-179, 179, 1), 180, 0.00001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Wrap(540), 180, 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(Motion.Wrap(-190), 170, 0.000001)
	end)

	Test.Case("Track: samples, measures, projects onto and walks a polyline, and tells points inside a unit box", function()
		local points = { vector.create(0, 0, 0), vector.create(1, 0, 0), vector.create(1, 0, 1) }
		local samples, distances = Track.Sample(points, 0.5, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(#samples, 5)
		Test.ExpectNear(samples[1], vector.create(0, 0, 0), 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(samples[3], vector.create(1, 0, 0), 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(samples[5], vector.create(1, 0, 1), 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(distances[5], 2, 0.000001)
		local offset = Track.Sample(points, 0.25, 0.125)
		Test.ExpectEqual(#offset, 8)
		Test.ExpectNear(offset[1], vector.create(0.125, 0, 0), 0.000001)
		Test.ExpectNear(offset[8], vector.create(1, 0, 0.875), 0.000001)
		Test.Expect(Track.InsideBox(vector.zero), "the centre is inside")
		for _, axis in { vector.create(1, 0, 0), vector.create(0, 1, 0), vector.create(0, 0, 1) } do
			Test.Expect(Track.InsideBox(axis * 0.5), "a face is inside")
			Test.Expect(Track.InsideBox(axis * -0.5), "the opposite face is inside")
			Test.Expect(not Track.InsideBox(axis * 0.51), "beyond a face is outside")
			Test.Expect(not Track.InsideBox(axis * -0.51), "beyond the opposite face is outside")
		end
		local lengths = Track.Lengths(points)
		Test.ExpectNear(lengths[3], 2, 0.000001)
		local along = Track.Project(points, lengths, vector.create(1.2, 0, 0.5), 1, 2)
		Test.ExpectNear(along, 1.5, 0.000001)
		local point = Track.PointAt(points, lengths, 1.25)
		Test.ExpectNear(point, vector.create(1, 0, 0.25), 0.000001)
	end)

	Test.Case("Track: a projection searches only its window of segments, clamped to the polyline", function()
		-- A doubled-back polyline: out along z = 0, a 1 m step, back along z = 1. The point lies 0.1 m from the way
		-- back (segment 3, 19 m along) and 0.9 m from the way out (segment 1, 2 m along).
		local points = { vector.create(0, 0, 0), vector.create(10, 0, 0), vector.create(10, 0, 1), vector.create(0, 0, 1) }
		local lengths = Track.Lengths(points)
		local position = vector.create(2, 0, 0.9)
		local along, segment = Track.Project(points, lengths, position, 1, 3)
		Test.ExpectNear(along, 19, 0.000001, "the whole polyline finds the way back")
		Test.ExpectEqual(segment, 3)
		along, segment = Track.Project(points, lengths, position, 1, 1)
		Test.ExpectNear(along, 2, 0.000001, "a window of the way out stays on it")
		Test.ExpectEqual(segment, 1)
		along, segment = Track.Project(points, lengths, position, -2, 2)
		Test.ExpectNear(along, 2, 0.000001, "a window starting before the polyline is clamped to its first segment")
		Test.ExpectEqual(segment, 1)
		along, segment = Track.Project(points, lengths, position, 3, 9)
		Test.ExpectNear(along, 19, 0.000001, "a window ending past the polyline is clamped to its last segment")
		Test.ExpectEqual(segment, 3)
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- Rolling Ball's integration suite (ADR 0038 decision 10): the main-path support check on every level, the respawn
-- at the last checkpoint, the goal and the timer carried across Scene.Load, the lift carrying the ball, a platform's
-- phased start, and Restart. The cases share one session and cross the levels by Scene.Load: the case during which a
-- transition is requested returns in that frame, and the next case runs in the new scene's VM.
local Actions = require("../Scripts/Actions")
local BallScript = require("../Scripts/Ball")
local Clock = require("../Scripts/Clock")
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")
local Motion = require("../Scripts/Motion")
local PlatformScript = require("../Scripts/MovingPlatform")
local Track = require("../Scripts/Track")

local Down = vector.create(0, -1, 0)
local Lift = vector.create(0, 0.5, 0)
-- The project's Simulation.FixedHz.
local FixedHz = 60

local function byName(a: Entity, b: Entity): boolean
	return a.Name < b.Name
end

local function find(path: string): Entity
	local entity = Scene.FindByPath(path)
	if not entity then
		Test.Fail("the scene has no " .. path)
	end
	return entity :: Entity
end

local function ballParts(): (Entity, BallScript.Ball, RigidBody)
	local entity = find("/Ball")
	return entity, entity:GetScript("Ball") :: BallScript.Ball, entity.RigidBody :: RigidBody
end

local function game(): GameScript.Game
	return find("/Game"):GetScript("Game") :: GameScript.Game
end

local function hudText(name: string): string
	local element = find("/HUD"):FindChild(name, true)
	local label = if element then element.UiText else nil
	return if label then label.Text else ""
end

-- Places the ball at rest (a test case may move it; recording suites never do).
local function place(body: RigidBody, position: vector)
	body:Teleport(position, Quat.Identity())
	body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
	body:SetAngularVelocity(vector.zero)
end

-- Presses Restart as a player would, and waits for the game to request its transition (it applies at the frame's
-- end, so the case returns in that frame and the next case runs in the scene it loads).
local function restart(current: GameScript.Game)
	Test.InjectAction(Actions.Restart, "Tap")
	Test.WaitUntil(function()
		return current.Leaving
	end, 5)
	Test.Expect(not current.LoadRequested, "a restart is not the next level's load")
end

-- The piece of the level a collider entity belongs to: its ancestor just below /Level.
local function pieceOf(entity: Entity): string
	local current = entity
	local parent = current:GetParent()
	while parent and parent.Name ~= "Level" do
		current = parent
		parent = current:GetParent()
	end
	return current.Name
end

-- The collider nearest to a point by its collider bounds, as "<collider> of <piece>".
local function nearestPiece(point: vector): string
	local best = "none"
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	for _, entity in Scene.FindAllWithComponent("BoxCollider") do
		local low, high = Physics.GetColliderBounds(entity)
		if low and high then
			local closest = vector.create(math.clamp(point.x, low.x, high.x), math.clamp(point.y, low.y, high.y), math.clamp(point.z, low.z, high.z))
			local distance = vector.magnitude(closest - point)
			if distance < bestDistance then
				bestDistance = distance
				best = string.format("%s of %s (%.2f m away)", entity.Name, pieceOf(entity), distance)
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- The main-path support check: every 0.25 m of the PathNode polyline, starting half a step in, outside every Gap
-- marker, has the Track layer below it.
local function supportCheck(minimumSamples: number)
	local nodes = Scene.FindAllByTag("PathNode")
	table.sort(nodes, byName)
	local points: { vector } = {}
	for index, node in nodes do
		points[index] = node.Transform.WorldPosition
	end
	local markers = Scene.FindAllByTag("Gap")
	local samples, distances = Track.Sample(points, 0.25, 0.125)
	Test.Expect(#samples >= minimumSamples, string.format("%d path samples, at least %d expected", #samples, minimumSamples))
	local mask = Physics.LayerMask("Track")
	local misses = 0
	for index, sample in samples do
		local inGap = false
		for _, marker in markers do
			if Track.InsideBox(marker.Transform:InverseTransformPoint(sample)) then
				inGap = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not inGap and not Physics.Raycast(sample + Lift, Down, 3, mask) then
			misses += 1
			if misses <= 8 then
				Test.Expect(false, string.format("no Track below the path at %.3f m, (%.3f, %.3f, %.3f); nearest: %s", distances[index], sample.x, sample.y, sample.z, nearestPiece(sample)))
			end
		end
	end
	Test.ExpectEqual(misses, 0, "path samples without support")
end

return Test.Suite("RollingBall", function()
	Test.Case("Level 1: the main path is supported everywhere but inside its gaps", function()
		supportCheck(400)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: a fall respawns the ball at the last checkpoint with no velocity", function()
		local ballEntity, ball, body = ballParts()
		local checkpoint = find("/Level/Checkpoint1")
		local root = checkpoint.Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, root + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.LastOrder == 1
		end, 30)
		local bar = checkpoint:FindChild("Bar") :: Entity
		local graph = checkpoint:GetScript("Checkpoint")
		Test.Expect(graph.Activated == true, "the checkpoint's graph is activated")
		Test.ExpectEqual((bar.MeshRenderer :: MeshRenderer):GetMaterial(1), graph.ActiveMaterial, "the bar shows the active material")
		local timerBefore = game().TotalTicks
		-- Over the void beside the track.
		place(body, root + vector.create(0, 1, 8))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.Respawns == 1
		end, 240)
		local velocity = body:GetLinearVelocity()
		Test.ExpectNear(ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition, root + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0), 0.05, "the ball respawned at the checkpoint")
		Test.Expect(vector.magnitude(velocity) < 0.01, string.format("linear speed %.4f after the respawn", vector.magnitude(velocity)))
		Test.Expect(vector.magnitude(body:GetAngularVelocity()) < 0.01, "no angular velocity after the respawn")
		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Heading, Motion.Wrap(checkpoint.Transform.EulerAngles.y), 0.001, "the heading is the checkpoint's yaw")
		Test.Expect(game().TotalTicks > timerBefore, "the timer kept running")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: rolling back through an earlier checkpoint never moves the spawn backwards", function()
		local ballEntity, ball, body = ballParts()
		local first = find("/Level/Checkpoint1").Transform.WorldPosition
		local second = find("/Level/Checkpoint2")
		local secondRoot = second.Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, secondRoot + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.LastOrder == 2
		end, 30)
		-- Back through Checkpoint1: the ball enters its trigger again and rests inside it.
		local respawns = ball.Respawns
		place(body, first + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(20)
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.LastOrder, 2, "an earlier checkpoint keeps the last order")
		-- Then a fall beside Checkpoint1.
		place(body, first + vector.create(0, 1, 8))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.Respawns == respawns + 1
		end, 240)
		Test.ExpectNear(ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition, secondRoot + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0), 0.05, "the ball respawned at Checkpoint2")
		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Heading, Motion.Wrap(second.Transform.EulerAngles.y), 0.001, "the heading is Checkpoint2's yaw")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: the goal stops the timer and loads Level 2 with it", function()
		local _, ball, body = ballParts()
		local goal = find("/Level/Goal").Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, goal + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.ReachedGoal
		end, 30)
		local current = game()
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.Finished
		end, 5)
		local stopped = current.TotalTicks
		Test.WaitTicks(10)
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, stopped, "the timer stopped")
		Test.Expect(string.sub(hudText("BannerText"), 1, 14) == "LEVEL COMPLETE", "the banner reads LEVEL COMPLETE: " .. hudText("BannerText"))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.LoadRequested
		end, current.LoadDelayTicks + 10)
		Test.Expect(current.Leaving, "the load is the level's one transition")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.SentParameters.ElapsedTicks, stopped, "Level 2 is loaded with the stopped time")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the timer carried across Scene.Load continues", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level2")
		local carried = Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(type(carried) == "number" and carried > 0, "Level 2 was loaded with the elapsed ticks")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.StartTicks, carried, "the game starts from the carried time")
		local before = current.TotalTicks
		Test.WaitTicks(60)
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, before + 60, "the timer counts on")
		Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("TimeText"), Clock.Format(current.TotalTicks), "the HUD shows the run's time")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the lift carries the ball up to the upper deck", function()
		local ballEntity, _, body = ballParts()
		local lift = find("/Level/Lift")
		local platform = lift:GetScript("MovingPlatform") :: PlatformScript.MovingPlatform
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return platform.AtStart and platform.DwellLeft > 45
		end, 700)
		-- The lift's root is its box's centre, 0.25 m below its top: the ball is placed 0.1 m above the top and
		-- measured once it has settled on it.
		place(body, lift.Transform.WorldPosition + vector.create(0, 0.85, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(20)
		local start = ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return platform.AtEnd
		end, 700)
		local finish = ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition
		Test.ExpectNear(finish.y - start.y, 4, 0.1, "the ball rose with the lift")
		local low, high = Physics.GetColliderBounds(lift)
		Test.Expect(low ~= nil and high ~= nil, "the lift has collider bounds")
		if low and high then
			Test.Expect(finish.x >= low.x and finish.x <= high.x and finish.z >= low.z and finish.z <= high.z, "the ball is still on the lift")
		end
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 1200 })

	Test.Case("Level 2: a platform started part-way through its cycle starts at its phased pose without a jump", function()
		local prefab = Assets.Load("Assets/Prefabs/MovingPlatform.prefab")
		Test.Expect(prefab ~= nil, "the MovingPlatform prefab loads")
		if not prefab then
			return
		end
		-- Away from the track and the ball; the authored pose is the cycle's start pose.
		local origin = vector.create(0, 20, 40)
		local entity = Scene.Instantiate(prefab, origin)
		local platform = entity:GetScript("MovingPlatform") :: PlatformScript.MovingPlatform
		-- Halfway up its rise, set before its first tick so that its OnStart reads it.
		platform.PhaseTicks = platform.DwellTicks + platform.MoveTicks // 2
		local phase = platform.PhaseTicks
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(platform.Tick, phase + 1, "the platform counts on from its phase")
		local expected = origin + platform.Travel * Motion.Ease(phase + 1, platform.MoveTicks, platform.DwellTicks)
		Test.ExpectNear(entity.Transform.WorldPosition, expected, 0.001, "the platform is at its phased pose")
		-- MoveKinematic covers its step in one tick: one tick of the ease is at most the rise's top speed, while a
		-- jump from the authored pose would cover half the travel in that tick.
		local fastest = vector.magnitude(platform.Travel) * math.pi / (2 * platform.MoveTicks) * FixedHz
		local speed = vector.magnitude((entity.RigidBody :: RigidBody):GetLinearVelocity())
		Test.Expect(speed <= fastest + 0.01, string.format("the platform moved at %.3f m/s, at most %.3f m/s expected", speed, fastest))
		Scene.Destroy(entity)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the main path is supported everywhere but inside its gaps", function()
		supportCheck(400)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: Restart reloads the level", function()
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(current.Ticks > 60, "the level has run before the restart")
		restart(current)
	end)

--!strict
-- A kinematic platform that dwells, eases along Travel, dwells and returns, counted in ticks (ADR 0038 decision 2).
local Motion = require("./Motion")

export type MovingPlatform = ScriptInstance & {
	Travel: vector,
	MoveTicks: number,
	DwellTicks: number,
	PhaseTicks: number,
	Tick: number,
	Start: vector,
	StartRotation: Quat,
	AtStart: boolean,
	AtEnd: boolean,
	DwellLeft: number,
}

local MovingPlatform = {}

MovingPlatform.Fields = {
	Travel = Field.Vector(vector.create(0, 4, 0)),
	MoveTicks = Field.Integer(180, { Min = 1 }),
	DwellTicks = Field.Integer(120, { Min = 0 }),
	PhaseTicks = Field.Integer(0, { Min = 0 }),
}

local function updatePhase(self: MovingPlatform)
	local atStart, atEnd, dwellLeft = Motion.Dwell(self.Tick, self.MoveTicks, self.DwellTicks)
	self.AtStart = atStart
	self.AtEnd = atEnd
	self.DwellLeft = dwellLeft
end

function MovingPlatform.OnStart(self: MovingPlatform)
	local transform = self.Entity.Transform
	self.Start = transform.WorldPosition
	self.StartRotation = transform.WorldRotation
	self.Tick = self.PhaseTicks
	updatePhase(self)
end

function MovingPlatform.OnFixedUpdate(self: MovingPlatform, _dt: number)
	local body = self.Entity.RigidBody
	if not body then
		return
	end
	self.Tick += 1
	local progress = Motion.Ease(self.Tick, self.MoveTicks, self.DwellTicks)
	body:MoveKinematic(self.Start + self.Travel * progress, self.StartRotation)
	updatePhase(self)
end

return Script.Define("MovingPlatform", MovingPlatform)

--!strict
-- Rolling Ball's integration suite (ADR 0038 decision 10): the main-path support check on every level, the respawn
-- at the last checkpoint, the goal and the timer carried across Scene.Load, the lift carrying the ball, a platform's
-- phased start, and Restart. The cases share one session and cross the levels by Scene.Load: the case during which a
-- transition is requested returns in that frame, and the next case runs in the new scene's VM.
local Actions = require("../Scripts/Actions")
local BallScript = require("../Scripts/Ball")
local Clock = require("../Scripts/Clock")
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")
local Motion = require("../Scripts/Motion")
local PlatformScript = require("../Scripts/MovingPlatform")
local Track = require("../Scripts/Track")

local Down = vector.create(0, -1, 0)
local Lift = vector.create(0, 0.5, 0)
-- The project's Simulation.FixedHz.
local FixedHz = 60

local function byName(a: Entity, b: Entity): boolean
	return a.Name < b.Name
end

local function find(path: string): Entity
	local entity = Scene.FindByPath(path)
	if not entity then
		Test.Fail("the scene has no " .. path)
	end
	return entity :: Entity
end

local function ballParts(): (Entity, BallScript.Ball, RigidBody)
	local entity = find("/Ball")
	return entity, entity:GetScript("Ball") :: BallScript.Ball, entity.RigidBody :: RigidBody
end

local function game(): GameScript.Game
	return find("/Game"):GetScript("Game") :: GameScript.Game
end

local function hudText(name: string): string
	local element = find("/HUD"):FindChild(name, true)
	local label = if element then element.UiText else nil
	return if label then label.Text else ""
end

-- Places the ball at rest (a test case may move it; recording suites never do).
local function place(body: RigidBody, position: vector)
	body:Teleport(position, Quat.Identity())
	body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
	body:SetAngularVelocity(vector.zero)
end

-- Presses Restart as a player would, and waits for the game to request its transition (it applies at the frame's
-- end, so the case returns in that frame and the next case runs in the scene it loads).
local function restart(current: GameScript.Game)
	Test.InjectAction(Actions.Restart, "Tap")
	Test.WaitUntil(function()
		return current.Leaving
	end, 5)
	Test.Expect(not current.LoadRequested, "a restart is not the next level's load")
end

-- The piece of the level a collider entity belongs to: its ancestor just below /Level.
local function pieceOf(entity: Entity): string
	local current = entity
	local parent = current:GetParent()
	while parent and parent.Name ~= "Level" do
		current = parent
		parent = current:GetParent()
	end
	return current.Name
end

-- The collider nearest to a point by its collider bounds, as "<collider> of <piece>".
local function nearestPiece(point: vector): string
	local best = "none"
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	for _, entity in Scene.FindAllWithComponent("BoxCollider") do
		local low, high = Physics.GetColliderBounds(entity)
		if low and high then
			local closest = vector.create(math.clamp(point.x, low.x, high.x), math.clamp(point.y, low.y, high.y), math.clamp(point.z, low.z, high.z))
			local distance = vector.magnitude(closest - point)
			if distance < bestDistance then
				bestDistance = distance
				best = string.format("%s of %s (%.2f m away)", entity.Name, pieceOf(entity), distance)
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- The main-path support check: every 0.25 m of the PathNode polyline, starting half a step in, outside every Gap
-- marker, has the Track layer below it.
local function supportCheck(minimumSamples: number)
	local nodes = Scene.FindAllByTag("PathNode")
	table.sort(nodes, byName)
	local points: { vector } = {}
	for index, node in nodes do
		points[index] = node.Transform.WorldPosition
	end
	local markers = Scene.FindAllByTag("Gap")
	local samples, distances = Track.Sample(points, 0.25, 0.125)
	Test.Expect(#samples >= minimumSamples, string.format("%d path samples, at least %d expected", #samples, minimumSamples))
	local mask = Physics.LayerMask("Track")
	local misses = 0
	for index, sample in samples do
		local inGap = false
		for _, marker in markers do
			if Track.InsideBox(marker.Transform:InverseTransformPoint(sample)) then
				inGap = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not inGap and not Physics.Raycast(sample + Lift, Down, 3, mask) then
			misses += 1
			if misses <= 8 then
				Test.Expect(false, string.format("no Track below the path at %.3f m, (%.3f, %.3f, %.3f); nearest: %s", distances[index], sample.x, sample.y, sample.z, nearestPiece(sample)))
			end
		end
	end
	Test.ExpectEqual(misses, 0, "path samples without support")
end

return Test.Suite("RollingBall", function()
	Test.Case("Level 1: the main path is supported everywhere but inside its gaps", function()
		supportCheck(400)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: a fall respawns the ball at the last checkpoint with no velocity", function()
		local ballEntity, ball, body = ballParts()
		local checkpoint = find("/Level/Checkpoint1")
		local root = checkpoint.Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, root + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.LastOrder == 1
		end, 30)
		local bar = checkpoint:FindChild("Bar") :: Entity
		local graph = checkpoint:GetScript("Checkpoint")
		Test.Expect(graph.Activated == true, "the checkpoint's graph is activated")
		Test.ExpectEqual((bar.MeshRenderer :: MeshRenderer):GetMaterial(1), graph.ActiveMaterial, "the bar shows the active material")
		local timerBefore = game().TotalTicks
		-- Over the void beside the track.
		place(body, root + vector.create(0, 1, 8))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.Respawns == 1
		end, 240)
		local velocity = body:GetLinearVelocity()
		Test.ExpectNear(ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition, root + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0), 0.05, "the ball respawned at the checkpoint")
		Test.Expect(vector.magnitude(velocity) < 0.01, string.format("linear speed %.4f after the respawn", vector.magnitude(velocity)))
		Test.Expect(vector.magnitude(body:GetAngularVelocity()) < 0.01, "no angular velocity after the respawn")
		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Heading, Motion.Wrap(checkpoint.Transform.EulerAngles.y), 0.001, "the heading is the checkpoint's yaw")
		Test.Expect(game().TotalTicks > timerBefore, "the timer kept running")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: rolling back through an earlier checkpoint never moves the spawn backwards", function()
		local ballEntity, ball, body = ballParts()
		local first = find("/Level/Checkpoint1").Transform.WorldPosition
		local second = find("/Level/Checkpoint2")
		local secondRoot = second.Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, secondRoot + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.LastOrder == 2
		end, 30)
		-- Back through Checkpoint1: the ball enters its trigger again and rests inside it.
		local respawns = ball.Respawns
		place(body, first + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(20)
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.LastOrder, 2, "an earlier checkpoint keeps the last order")
		-- Then a fall beside Checkpoint1.
		place(body, first + vector.create(0, 1, 8))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.Respawns == respawns + 1
		end, 240)
		Test.ExpectNear(ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition, secondRoot + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0), 0.05, "the ball respawned at Checkpoint2")
		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Heading, Motion.Wrap(second.Transform.EulerAngles.y), 0.001, "the heading is Checkpoint2's yaw")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: the goal stops the timer and loads Level 2 with it", function()
		local _, ball, body = ballParts()
		local goal = find("/Level/Goal").Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, goal + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.ReachedGoal
		end, 30)
		local current = game()
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.Finished
		end, 5)
		local stopped = current.TotalTicks
		Test.WaitTicks(10)
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, stopped, "the timer stopped")
		Test.Expect(string.sub(hudText("BannerText"), 1, 14) == "LEVEL COMPLETE", "the banner reads LEVEL COMPLETE: " .. hudText("BannerText"))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.LoadRequested
		end, current.LoadDelayTicks + 10)
		Test.Expect(current.Leaving, "the load is the level's one transition")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.SentParameters.ElapsedTicks, stopped, "Level 2 is loaded with the stopped time")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the timer carried across Scene.Load continues", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level2")
		local carried = Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(type(carried) == "number" and carried > 0, "Level 2 was loaded with the elapsed ticks")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.StartTicks, carried, "the game starts from the carried time")
		local before = current.TotalTicks
		Test.WaitTicks(60)
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, before + 60, "the timer counts on")
		Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("TimeText"), Clock.Format(current.TotalTicks), "the HUD shows the run's time")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the lift carries the ball up to the upper deck", function()
		local ballEntity, _, body = ballParts()
		local lift = find("/Level/Lift")
		local platform = lift:GetScript("MovingPlatform") :: PlatformScript.MovingPlatform
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return platform.AtStart and platform.DwellLeft > 45
		end, 700)
		-- The lift's root is its box's centre, 0.25 m below its top: the ball is placed 0.1 m above the top and
		-- measured once it has settled on it.
		place(body, lift.Transform.WorldPosition + vector.create(0, 0.85, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(20)
		local start = ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return platform.AtEnd
		end, 700)
		local finish = ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition
		Test.ExpectNear(finish.y - start.y, 4, 0.1, "the ball rose with the lift")
		local low, high = Physics.GetColliderBounds(lift)
		Test.Expect(low ~= nil and high ~= nil, "the lift has collider bounds")
		if low and high then
			Test.Expect(finish.x >= low.x and finish.x <= high.x and finish.z >= low.z and finish.z <= high.z, "the ball is still on the lift")
		end
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 1200 })

	Test.Case("Level 2: a platform started part-way through its cycle starts at its phased pose without a jump", function()
		local prefab = Assets.Load("Assets/Prefabs/MovingPlatform.prefab")
		local behaviour = Assets.Load("Assets/Scripts/MovingPlatform.luau")
		Test.Expect(prefab ~= nil and behaviour ~= nil, "the MovingPlatform prefab and behaviour load")
		if not prefab or not behaviour then
			return
		end
		-- Away from the track and the ball. After two ticks the instance's body is in the world, dwelling at its
		-- authored pose, the cycle's start pose.
		local origin = vector.create(0, 20, 40)
		local entity = Scene.Instantiate(prefab, origin)
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		-- A new instance of the behaviour, its phase halfway up the rise in its slot's fields, which its OnStart reads.
		local scripts = entity:GetComponent("Script")
		scripts.Scripts = {}
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local phase = 210
		scripts.Scripts = { { Script = behaviour, Fields = { PhaseTicks = phase }, ExecutionOrder = 0 } }
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local platform = entity:GetScript("MovingPlatform") :: PlatformScript.MovingPlatform
		Test.ExpectEqual(platform.PhaseTicks, phase, "the new instance has the phase")
		Test.ExpectEqual(platform.Tick, phase + 1, "the platform counts on from its phase")

		-- MoveKinematic covers its step in one tick: one tick of the ease is at most the rise's top speed, while a
		-- jump from the authored pose would cover half the travel in that tick.

		Test.Expect(speed <= fastest + 0.01, string.format("the platform moved at %.3f m/s, at most %.3f m/s expected", speed, fastest))
		Scene.Destroy(entity)
	end)

		supportCheck(400)
	end)

		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(current.Ticks > 60, "the level has run before the restart")
		restart(current)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the restarted level starts again from the time it was entered with", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level2")

		local current = game()
		local ballEntity, ball = ballParts()
		Test.Expect(type(carried) == "number" and carried > 0, "the reload keeps the elapsed ticks Level 2 was loaded with")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.StartTicks, carried, "the timer starts again from the carried time")
		Test.Expect(current.Ticks < 10, string.format("the level's own time starts again (%d ticks)", current.Ticks))
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, current.StartTicks + current.Ticks, "the run's time is the carried time plus the level's")
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.Respawns, 0, "the ball starts afresh")
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.LastOrder, 0, "no checkpoint is touched")
		Test.ExpectNear(ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition, ball.Spawn, 0.15, "the ball is back at the level's start")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: its next level is Level 3, which the suite loads with a carried time", function()
		local nextLevel = game().NextLevel
		Test.Expect(nextLevel ~= nil, "Level 2 names its next level")
		if nextLevel then
			Scene.Load(nextLevel, { ElapsedTicks = 3600 })
		end
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 3: the main path is supported everywhere but inside its gaps", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level3")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks, 3600, "Level 3 was loaded with the suite's time")
		supportCheck(500)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 3: the goal shows the finish with the total time", function()
		local _, ball, body = ballParts()
		local goal = find("/Level/Goal").Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, goal + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.ReachedGoal
		end, 30)
		local current = game()
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.Finished
		end, 5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("BannerText"), "FINISHED  " .. Clock.Format(current.TotalTicks) .. "\nPRESS R TO PLAY AGAIN", "the banner shows the run's time")
		Test.WaitTicks(current.LoadDelayTicks + 10)
		Test.Expect(not current.LoadRequested and not current.Leaving, "the last level loads nothing")
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 300 })

	Test.Case("Level 3: Restart after the finish starts a new run", function()
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(current.Finished, "Level 3 is finished")
		restart(current)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: the new run starts on Level 1 with no time", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level1")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks, nil, "Level 1 is loaded without a carried time")
		local current = game()

--!strict
-- A kinematic platform that dwells, eases along Travel, dwells and returns, counted in ticks (ADR 0038 decision 2).
-- Its authored pose is the cycle's start pose; PhaseTicks starts it that far into the cycle.
local Motion = require("./Motion")

export type MovingPlatform = ScriptInstance & {
	Travel: vector,
	MoveTicks: number,
	DwellTicks: number,
	PhaseTicks: number,
	Tick: number,
	Start: vector,
	StartRotation: Quat,
	AtStart: boolean,
	AtEnd: boolean,
	DwellLeft: number,
}

local MovingPlatform = {}

MovingPlatform.Fields = {
	Travel = Field.Vector(vector.create(0, 4, 0)),
	MoveTicks = Field.Integer(180, { Min = 1 }),
	DwellTicks = Field.Integer(120, { Min = 0 }),
	PhaseTicks = Field.Integer(0, { Min = 0 }),
}

local function updatePhase(self: MovingPlatform)
	local atStart, atEnd, dwellLeft = Motion.Dwell(self.Tick, self.MoveTicks, self.DwellTicks)
	self.AtStart = atStart
	self.AtEnd = atEnd
	self.DwellLeft = dwellLeft
end

function MovingPlatform.OnStart(self: MovingPlatform)
	local transform = self.Entity.Transform
	self.Start = transform.WorldPosition
	self.StartRotation = transform.WorldRotation
	self.Tick = self.PhaseTicks
	local body = self.Entity.RigidBody
	if body and self.PhaseTicks ~= 0 then
		-- Start at the phased pose, so the first tick moves one tick's step instead of jumping there and launching
		-- whatever rides the platform.
		body:Teleport(self.Start + self.Travel * Motion.Ease(self.Tick, self.MoveTicks, self.DwellTicks), self.StartRotation)
	end
	updatePhase(self)
end

function MovingPlatform.OnFixedUpdate(self: MovingPlatform, _dt: number)
	local body = self.Entity.RigidBody
	if not body then
		return
	end
	self.Tick += 1
	local progress = Motion.Ease(self.Tick, self.MoveTicks, self.DwellTicks)
	body:MoveKinematic(self.Start + self.Travel * progress, self.StartRotation)
	updatePhase(self)
end

return Script.Define("MovingPlatform", MovingPlatform)

--!strict
-- Rolling Ball's integration suite (ADR 0038 decision 10): the main-path support check on every level, the respawn
-- at the last checkpoint, the goal and the timer carried across Scene.Load, the lift carrying the ball, a platform's
-- phased start, and Restart. The cases share one session and cross the levels by Scene.Load: the case during which a
-- transition is requested returns in that frame, and the next case runs in the new scene's VM.
local Actions = require("../Scripts/Actions")
local BallScript = require("../Scripts/Ball")
local Clock = require("../Scripts/Clock")
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")
local Motion = require("../Scripts/Motion")
local PlatformScript = require("../Scripts/MovingPlatform")
local Track = require("../Scripts/Track")

local Down = vector.create(0, -1, 0)
local Lift = vector.create(0, 0.5, 0)

local function byName(a: Entity, b: Entity): boolean
	return a.Name < b.Name
end

local function find(path: string): Entity
	local entity = Scene.FindByPath(path)
	if not entity then
		Test.Fail("the scene has no " .. path)
	end
	return entity :: Entity
end

local function ballParts(): (Entity, BallScript.Ball, RigidBody)
	local entity = find("/Ball")
	return entity, entity:GetScript("Ball") :: BallScript.Ball, entity.RigidBody :: RigidBody
end

local function game(): GameScript.Game
	return find("/Game"):GetScript("Game") :: GameScript.Game
end

local function hudText(name: string): string
	local element = find("/HUD"):FindChild(name, true)
	local label = if element then element.UiText else nil
	return if label then label.Text else ""
end

-- Places the ball at rest (a test case may move it; recording suites never do).
local function place(body: RigidBody, position: vector)
	body:Teleport(position, Quat.Identity())
	body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
	body:SetAngularVelocity(vector.zero)
end

-- Presses Restart as a player would, and waits for the game to request its transition (it applies at the frame's
-- end, so the case returns in that frame and the next case runs in the scene it loads).
local function restart(current: GameScript.Game)
	Test.InjectAction(Actions.Restart, "Tap")
	Test.WaitUntil(function()
		return current.Leaving
	end, 5)
	Test.Expect(not current.LoadRequested, "a restart is not the next level's load")
end

-- The piece of the level a collider entity belongs to: its ancestor just below /Level.
local function pieceOf(entity: Entity): string
	local current = entity
	local parent = current:GetParent()
	while parent and parent.Name ~= "Level" do
		current = parent
		parent = current:GetParent()
	end
	return current.Name
end

-- The collider nearest to a point by its collider bounds, as "<collider> of <piece>".
local function nearestPiece(point: vector): string
	local best = "none"
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	for _, entity in Scene.FindAllWithComponent("BoxCollider") do
		local low, high = Physics.GetColliderBounds(entity)
		if low and high then
			local closest = vector.create(math.clamp(point.x, low.x, high.x), math.clamp(point.y, low.y, high.y), math.clamp(point.z, low.z, high.z))
			local distance = vector.magnitude(closest - point)
			if distance < bestDistance then
				bestDistance = distance
				best = string.format("%s of %s (%.2f m away)", entity.Name, pieceOf(entity), distance)
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- The main-path support check: every 0.25 m of the PathNode polyline, starting half a step in, outside every Gap
-- marker, has the Track layer below it.
local function supportCheck(minimumSamples: number)
	local nodes = Scene.FindAllByTag("PathNode")
	table.sort(nodes, byName)
	local points: { vector } = {}
	for index, node in nodes do
		points[index] = node.Transform.WorldPosition
	end
	local markers = Scene.FindAllByTag("Gap")
	local samples, distances = Track.Sample(points, 0.25, 0.125)
	Test.Expect(#samples >= minimumSamples, string.format("%d path samples, at least %d expected", #samples, minimumSamples))
	local mask = Physics.LayerMask("Track")
	local misses = 0
	for index, sample in samples do
		local inGap = false
		for _, marker in markers do

				break
			end
		end
		if not inGap and not Physics.Raycast(sample + Lift, Down, 3, mask) then
			misses += 1
			if misses <= 8 then
				Test.Expect(false, string.format("no Track below the path at %.3f m, (%.3f, %.3f, %.3f); nearest: %s", distances[index], sample.x, sample.y, sample.z, nearestPiece(sample)))
			end
		end
	end
	Test.ExpectEqual(misses, 0, "path samples without support")
end

		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Heading, Motion.Wrap(checkpoint.Transform.EulerAngles.y), 0.001, "the heading is the checkpoint's yaw")

		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Heading, Motion.Wrap(second.Transform.EulerAngles.y), 0.001, "the heading is Checkpoint2's yaw")
	end)

		local goal = find("/Level/Goal").Transform.WorldPosition

		local current = game()

			return platform.AtStart and platform.DwellLeft > 45
		end, 700)
		-- The lift's root is its box's centre, 0.25 m below its top: the ball is placed 0.1 m above the top and
		-- measured once it has settled on it.
		place(body, lift.Transform.WorldPosition + vector.create(0, 0.85, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(20)
		local start = ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return platform.AtEnd
		end, 700)
		local finish = ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition
		Test.ExpectNear(finish.y - start.y, 4, 0.1, "the ball rose with the lift")
		local low, high = Physics.GetColliderBounds(lift)
		Test.Expect(low ~= nil and high ~= nil, "the lift has collider bounds")
		if low and high then
			Test.Expect(finish.x >= low.x and finish.x <= high.x and finish.z >= low.z and finish.z <= high.z, "the ball is still on the lift")
		end
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 1200 })

	Test.Case("Level 2: a platform started part-way through its cycle moves on from its phased pose", function()
		local prefab = Assets.Load("Assets/Prefabs/MovingPlatform.prefab")
		Test.Expect(prefab ~= nil, "the MovingPlatform prefab loads")
		if not prefab then
			return
		end
		-- Away from the track and the ball; the authored pose is the cycle's start pose. The phase, halfway up the
		-- rise, is set before the instance's first tick, so that its OnStart reads it. A script cannot see the first
		-- tick's step itself (that tick both starts and moves the platform), so the case checks the poses it reaches.
		local origin = vector.create(0, 20, 40)
		local entity = Scene.Instantiate(prefab, origin)
		local platform = entity:GetScript("MovingPlatform") :: PlatformScript.MovingPlatform
		platform.PhaseTicks = platform.DwellTicks + platform.MoveTicks // 2
		local phase = platform.PhaseTicks
		for step = 1, 2 do
			Test.WaitTicks(1)
			Test.ExpectEqual(platform.Tick, phase + step, "the platform counts on from its phase")
			local expected = origin + platform.Travel * Motion.Ease(phase + step, platform.MoveTicks, platform.DwellTicks)
			Test.ExpectNear(entity.Transform.WorldPosition, expected, 0.001, string.format("the platform's pose %d ticks on from its phase", step))
		end
		Scene.Destroy(entity)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the main path is supported everywhere but inside its gaps", function()
		supportCheck(400)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: Restart reloads the level", function()
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(current.Ticks > 60, "the level has run before the restart")
		restart(current)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the restarted level starts again from the time it was entered with", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level2")
		local carried = Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks
		local current = game()
		local ballEntity, ball = ballParts()
		Test.Expect(type(carried) == "number" and carried > 0, "the reload keeps the elapsed ticks Level 2 was loaded with")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.StartTicks, carried, "the timer starts again from the carried time")
		Test.Expect(current.Ticks < 10, string.format("the level's own time starts again (%d ticks)", current.Ticks))
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, current.StartTicks + current.Ticks, "the run's time is the carried time plus the level's")
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.Respawns, 0, "the ball starts afresh")
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.LastOrder, 0, "no checkpoint is touched")
		Test.ExpectNear(ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition, ball.Spawn, 0.15, "the ball is back at the level's start")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: its next level is Level 3, which the suite loads with a carried time", function()
		local nextLevel = game().NextLevel
		Test.Expect(nextLevel ~= nil, "Level 2 names its next level")
		if nextLevel then
			Scene.Load(nextLevel, { ElapsedTicks = 3600 })
		end
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 3: the main path is supported everywhere but inside its gaps", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level3")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks, 3600, "Level 3 was loaded with the suite's time")
		supportCheck(500)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 3: the goal shows the finish with the total time", function()
		local _, ball, body = ballParts()
		local goal = find("/Level/Goal").Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, goal + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.ReachedGoal
		end, 30)
		local current = game()
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.Finished
		end, 5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("BannerText"), "FINISHED  " .. Clock.Format(current.TotalTicks) .. "\nPRESS R TO PLAY AGAIN", "the banner shows the run's time")
		Test.WaitTicks(current.LoadDelayTicks + 10)
		Test.Expect(not current.LoadRequested and not current.Leaving, "the last level loads nothing")
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 300 })

	Test.Case("Level 3: Restart after the finish starts a new run", function()
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(current.Finished, "Level 3 is finished")
		restart(current)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: the new run starts on Level 1 with no time", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level1")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks, nil, "Level 1 is loaded without a carried time")
		local current = game()
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.StartTicks, 0, "the new run's timer starts at 0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, current.Ticks, "the run's time is Level 1's own")
	end)
end)

params.source:
--!strict
-- Rolling Ball's integration suite (ADR 0038 decision 10): the main-path support check and the HUD's level and par on
-- every level, the respawn at the last checkpoint, the CHECKPOINT banner, the goal and the timer carried across
-- Scene.Load, the lift carrying the ball, a platform's phased start, and Restart. The cases share one session and cross
-- the levels by Scene.Load: the case during which a transition is requested returns in that frame, and the next case
-- runs in the new scene's VM.
local Actions = require("../Scripts/Actions")
local BallScript = require("../Scripts/Ball")
local Clock = require("../Scripts/Clock")
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")
local Motion = require("../Scripts/Motion")
local PlatformScript = require("../Scripts/MovingPlatform")
local Track = require("../Scripts/Track")

local Down = vector.create(0, -1, 0)
local Lift = vector.create(0, 0.5, 0)

local function byName(a: Entity, b: Entity): boolean
	return a.Name < b.Name
end

local function find(path: string): Entity
	local entity = Scene.FindByPath(path)
	if not entity then
		Test.Fail("the scene has no " .. path)
	end
	return entity :: Entity
end

local function ballParts(): (Entity, BallScript.Ball, RigidBody)
	local entity = find("/Ball")
	return entity, entity:GetScript("Ball") :: BallScript.Ball, entity.RigidBody :: RigidBody
end

local function game(): GameScript.Game
	return find("/Game"):GetScript("Game") :: GameScript.Game
end

local function hudText(name: string): string
	local element = find("/HUD"):FindChild(name, true)
	local label = if element then element.UiText else nil
	return if label then label.Text else ""
end

-- The HUD's level and par, which the game writes once at the level's start.
local function expectHud(level: number)
	Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("LevelText"), string.format("LEVEL %d/3", level), "the HUD names the level")
	Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("ParText"), "PAR " .. Clock.Format(game().ParTicks), "the HUD shows the level's par")
end

-- Places the ball at rest (a test case may move it; recording suites never do).
local function place(body: RigidBody, position: vector)
	body:Teleport(position, Quat.Identity())
	body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
	body:SetAngularVelocity(vector.zero)
end

-- Presses Restart as a player would, and waits for the game to request its transition (it applies at the frame's
-- end, so the case returns in that frame and the next case runs in the scene it loads).
local function restart(current: GameScript.Game)
	Test.InjectAction(Actions.Restart, "Tap")
	Test.WaitUntil(function()
		return current.Leaving
	end, 5)
	Test.Expect(not current.LoadRequested, "a restart is not the next level's load")
end

-- The piece of the level a collider entity belongs to: its ancestor just below /Level.
local function pieceOf(entity: Entity): string
	local current = entity
	local parent = current:GetParent()
	while parent and parent.Name ~= "Level" do
		current = parent
		parent = current:GetParent()
	end
	return current.Name
end

-- The solid collider nearest to a point by its collider bounds, as "<collider> of <piece>". Trigger volumes (the
-- checkpoints' and the goal's) are left out: a miss inside one would otherwise name the trigger, not the track.
local function nearestPiece(point: vector): string
	local best = "none"
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	for _, entity in Scene.FindAllWithComponent("BoxCollider") do
		local collider = entity.BoxCollider
		if collider and not collider.IsTrigger then
			local low, high = Physics.GetColliderBounds(entity)
			if low and high then
				local closest = vector.create(math.clamp(point.x, low.x, high.x), math.clamp(point.y, low.y, high.y), math.clamp(point.z, low.z, high.z))
				local distance = vector.magnitude(closest - point)
				if distance < bestDistance then
					bestDistance = distance
					best = string.format("%s of %s (%.2f m away)", entity.Name, pieceOf(entity), distance)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- DEMO (temporary, S4): S3's nearestPiece, which searched every BoxCollider, triggers included.
local function nearestPieceAnyCollider(point: vector): string
	local best = "none"
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	for _, entity in Scene.FindAllWithComponent("BoxCollider") do
		local low, high = Physics.GetColliderBounds(entity)
		if low and high then
			local closest = vector.create(math.clamp(point.x, low.x, high.x), math.clamp(point.y, low.y, high.y), math.clamp(point.z, low.z, high.z))
			local distance = vector.magnitude(closest - point)
			if distance < bestDistance then
				bestDistance = distance
				best = string.format("%s of %s (%.2f m away)", entity.Name, pieceOf(entity), distance)
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- The main-path support check: every 0.25 m of the PathNode polyline, starting half a step in, outside every Gap
-- marker, has the Track layer below it.
local function supportCheck(minimumSamples: number)
	local nodes = Scene.FindAllByTag("PathNode")
	table.sort(nodes, byName)
	local points: { vector } = {}
	for index, node in nodes do
		points[index] = node.Transform.WorldPosition
	end
	local markers = Scene.FindAllByTag("Gap")
	local samples, distances = Track.Sample(points, 0.25, 0.125)
	Test.Expect(#samples >= minimumSamples, string.format("%d path samples, at least %d expected", #samples, minimumSamples))
	local mask = Physics.LayerMask("Track")
	local misses = 0
	for index, sample in samples do
		local inGap = false
		for _, marker in markers do
			if Track.InsideBox(marker.Transform:InverseTransformPoint(sample)) then
				inGap = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not inGap and not Physics.Raycast(sample + Lift, Down, 3, mask) then
			misses += 1
			if misses <= 8 then
				Test.Expect(false, string.format("no Track below the path at %.3f m, (%.3f, %.3f, %.3f); nearest: %s", distances[index], sample.x, sample.y, sample.z, nearestPiece(sample)))
			end
		end
	end
	Test.ExpectEqual(misses, 0, "path samples without support")
end

return Test.Suite("RollingBall", function()
	Test.Case("Level 1: the main path is supported everywhere but inside its gaps", function()
		supportCheck(400)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: the HUD shows the level and its par", function()
		expectHud(1)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: a fall respawns the ball at the last checkpoint with no velocity", function()
		local ballEntity, ball, body = ballParts()
		local checkpoint = find("/Level/Checkpoint1")
		local root = checkpoint.Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, root + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.LastOrder == 1
		end, 30)

--!strict
-- Rolling Ball's frame-timing suite (ADR 0038 decision 10; the review's G6). It runs on a ScriptedClock (its
-- Testing.Suites entry's Clock) whose frames each run several fixed steps, as live play's frames may. A scene
-- transition requested in a fixed step applies only at the frame's end, and the frame's later steps still run in the
-- current scene, where a second request would raise InvalidState: Game.luau's Leaving flag requests one transition at
-- most. The case during which the transition is requested returns in the frame's last step, and the next case runs in
-- the scene it loads.
local Actions = require("../Scripts/Actions")
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")

local function find(path: string): Entity
	local entity = Scene.FindByPath(path)
	if not entity then
		Test.Fail("the scene has no " .. path)
	end
	return entity :: Entity
end

local function game(): GameScript.Game
	return find("/Game"):GetScript("Game") :: GameScript.Game
end

return Test.Suite("Frames", function()
	Test.Case("Level 1: Restart in the frame its delayed load falls due requests one transition", function()
		local current = game()
		local body = find("/Ball").RigidBody :: RigidBody
		-- The clock's frames: a tick in another frame than the tick before it starts a frame.
		local starts: { number } = {}
		local frame = Time.GetFrameCount()
		while #starts < 3 do
			Test.WaitTicks(1)
			if Time.GetFrameCount() ~= frame then
				frame = Time.GetFrameCount()
				table.insert(starts, Time.GetTick())
			end
		end
		local steps = starts[2] - starts[1]
		Test.ExpectEqual(starts[3] - starts[2], steps, "every frame runs as many fixed steps")
		Test.Expect(steps >= 2, string.format("a frame runs several fixed steps (%d)", steps))
		-- The ball placed on the goal's trigger enters it in that tick's physics step, so the game finishes in the next
		-- tick, F. Its delayed load falls due when FinishedTicks reaches LoadDelayTicks: at F + LoadDelayTicks, or a
		-- tick later after a Restart pressed before then, since the press's tick returns before FinishedTicks counts.
		-- The case presses Restart at F + LoadDelayTicks, so the load falls due in the next step,
		-- F + LoadDelayTicks + 1, placed as the last step of its frame.
		local delay = current.LoadDelayTicks
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return (Time.GetTick() + delay + 3 - starts[1]) % steps == 0
		end, steps)
		local placed = Time.GetTick()
		body:Teleport(find("/Level/Goal").Transform.WorldPosition + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0), Quat.Identity())
		body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
		body:SetAngularVelocity(vector.zero)
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.Finished
		end, 30)
		local finished = Time.GetTick()
		-- A press injected in this tick is the next tick's input.
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.FinishedTicks == delay - 1
		end, delay + 10)
		Test.InjectAction(Actions.Restart, "Tap")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local pressed = Time.GetTick()
		local pressFrame = Time.GetFrameCount()
		Test.Expect(current.Leaving and not current.LoadRequested, "the press requested the restart")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local timeline = string.format("placed in tick %d, finished in %d, pressed in %d, due in %d; frames of %d steps from tick %d", placed, finished, pressed, Time.GetTick(), steps, starts[1])
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetFrameCount(), pressFrame, "the press and the step the load falls due in share a frame: " .. timeline)
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.FinishedTicks, delay, "the delayed load falls due in this step: " .. timeline)
		Test.Expect(not current.LoadRequested, "no load is requested after the restart")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#Test.GetScriptErrors(), 0, "no script error")
		Test.Expect(false, "DEMO G6 " .. timeline .. string.format(", frame %d", Time.GetFrameCount()))
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: the restart reloads Level 1, not Level 2", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level1", "the restart's reload took effect, not the delayed load")
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(not current.Finished and not current.Leaving, "the reloaded level runs afresh")
		Test.Expect(current.Ticks < 10, string.format("the level's own time starts again (%d ticks)", current.Ticks))
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.StartTicks, 0, "Level 1 starts again with no carried time")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#Test.GetScriptErrors(), 0, "no script error in the run")
		Test.Expect(false, string.format("DEMO G6 the next case: tick %d, frame %d, Ticks %d", Time.GetTick(), Time.GetFrameCount(), current.Ticks))
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- Rolling Ball's frame-timing suite (ADR 0038 decision 10; the review's G6). It runs on a ScriptedClock (its
-- Testing.Suites entry's Clock) whose frames each run several fixed steps, as live play's frames may. A scene
-- transition requested in a fixed step applies only at the frame's end, and the frame's later steps still run in the
-- current scene, where a second request would raise InvalidState: Game.luau's Leaving flag requests one transition at
-- most. The case during which the transition is requested returns in the frame's last step, and the next case runs in
-- the scene it loads.
local Actions = require("../Scripts/Actions")
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")

local function find(path: string): Entity
	local entity = Scene.FindByPath(path)
	if not entity then
		Test.Fail("the scene has no " .. path)
	end
	return entity :: Entity
end

local function game(): GameScript.Game
	return find("/Game"):GetScript("Game") :: GameScript.Game
end

return Test.Suite("Frames", function()
	Test.Case("Level 1: Restart in the frame its delayed load falls due requests one transition", function()
		local current = game()
		local body = find("/Ball").RigidBody :: RigidBody
		-- The clock's frames: a tick in another frame than the tick before it starts a frame.
		local starts: { number } = {}
		local frame = Time.GetFrameCount()
		while #starts < 3 do
			Test.WaitTicks(1)
			if Time.GetFrameCount() ~= frame then
				frame = Time.GetFrameCount()
				table.insert(starts, Time.GetTick())
			end
		end
		local steps = starts[2] - starts[1]
		Test.ExpectEqual(starts[3] - starts[2], steps, "every frame runs as many fixed steps")
		Test.Expect(steps >= 2, string.format("a frame runs several fixed steps (%d)", steps))
		-- The ball placed on the goal's trigger enters it in that tick's physics step, so the game finishes in the next
		-- tick, F. Its delayed load falls due when FinishedTicks reaches LoadDelayTicks: at F + LoadDelayTicks, or a
		-- tick later after a Restart pressed before then, since the press's tick returns before FinishedTicks counts.
		-- The case presses Restart at F + LoadDelayTicks, so the load falls due in the next step,
		-- F + LoadDelayTicks + 1, placed as the last step of its frame.
		local delay = current.LoadDelayTicks
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return (Time.GetTick() + delay + 3 - starts[1]) % steps == 0
		end, steps)
		local placed = Time.GetTick()
		body:Teleport(find("/Level/Goal").Transform.WorldPosition + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0), Quat.Identity())
		body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
		body:SetAngularVelocity(vector.zero)
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.Finished
		end, 30)
		local finished = Time.GetTick()
		-- A press injected in this tick is the next tick's input.
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.FinishedTicks == delay - 1
		end, delay + 10)
		Test.InjectAction(Actions.Restart, "Tap")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local pressed = Time.GetTick()
		local pressFrame = Time.GetFrameCount()
		Test.Expect(current.Leaving and not current.LoadRequested, "the press requested the restart")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		-- Without the Leaving flag the game would request the delayed load here, a second transition in the frame,
		-- which raises InvalidState in its OnFixedUpdate before this case resumes.
		local timeline = string.format("placed in tick %d, finished in %d, pressed in %d, due in %d; frames of %d steps from tick %d", placed, finished, pressed, Time.GetTick(), steps, starts[1])
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetFrameCount(), pressFrame, "the press and the step the load falls due in share a frame: " .. timeline)
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.FinishedTicks, delay, "the delayed load falls due in this step: " .. timeline)
		Test.Expect(not current.LoadRequested, "no load is requested after the restart")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#Test.GetScriptErrors(), 0, "no script error")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: the restart reloads Level 1, not Level 2", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level1", "the restart's reload took effect, not the delayed load")
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(not current.Finished and not current.Leaving, "the reloaded level runs afresh")
		Test.Expect(current.Ticks < 10, string.format("the level's own time starts again (%d ticks)", current.Ticks))
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.StartTicks, 0, "Level 1 starts again with no carried time")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- Rolling Ball's integration suite (ADR 0038 decision 10): the main-path support check and the HUD's level and par on
-- every level, the respawn at the last checkpoint, the CHECKPOINT banner, the goal and the timer carried across
-- Scene.Load, the lift carrying the ball, a platform's phased start, and Restart. The cases share one session and cross
-- the levels by Scene.Load: the case during which a transition is requested returns in that frame, and the next case
-- runs in the new scene's VM.
local Actions = require("../Scripts/Actions")
local BallScript = require("../Scripts/Ball")
local Clock = require("../Scripts/Clock")
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")
local Motion = require("../Scripts/Motion")
local PlatformScript = require("../Scripts/MovingPlatform")
local Track = require("../Scripts/Track")

local Down = vector.create(0, -1, 0)
local Lift = vector.create(0, 0.5, 0)

local function byName(a: Entity, b: Entity): boolean
	return a.Name < b.Name
end

local function find(path: string): Entity
	local entity = Scene.FindByPath(path)
	if not entity then
		Test.Fail("the scene has no " .. path)
	end
	return entity :: Entity
end

local function ballParts(): (Entity, BallScript.Ball, RigidBody)
	local entity = find("/Ball")
	return entity, entity:GetScript("Ball") :: BallScript.Ball, entity.RigidBody :: RigidBody
end

local function game(): GameScript.Game
	return find("/Game"):GetScript("Game") :: GameScript.Game
end

local function hudText(name: string): string
	local element = find("/HUD"):FindChild(name, true)
	local label = if element then element.UiText else nil
	return if label then label.Text else ""
end

-- The HUD's level and par, which the game writes once at the level's start.
local function expectHud(level: number)
	Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("LevelText"), string.format("LEVEL %d/3", level), "the HUD names the level")
	Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("ParText"), "PAR " .. Clock.Format(game().ParTicks), "the HUD shows the level's par")
end

-- Places the ball at rest (a test case may move it; recording suites never do).
local function place(body: RigidBody, position: vector)
	body:Teleport(position, Quat.Identity())
	body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
	body:SetAngularVelocity(vector.zero)
end

-- Presses Restart as a player would, and waits for the game to request its transition (it applies at the frame's
-- end, so the case returns in that frame and the next case runs in the scene it loads).
local function restart(current: GameScript.Game)
	Test.InjectAction(Actions.Restart, "Tap")
	Test.WaitUntil(function()
		return current.Leaving
	end, 5)
	Test.Expect(not current.LoadRequested, "a restart is not the next level's load")
end

-- The piece of the level a collider entity belongs to: its ancestor just below /Level.
local function pieceOf(entity: Entity): string
	local current = entity
	local parent = current:GetParent()
	while parent and parent.Name ~= "Level" do
		current = parent
		parent = current:GetParent()
	end
	return current.Name
end

-- The solid collider nearest to a point by its collider bounds, as "<collider> of <piece>". Trigger volumes (the
-- checkpoints' and the goal's) are left out: a miss inside one would otherwise name the trigger, not the track.
local function nearestPiece(point: vector): string
	local best = "none"
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	for _, entity in Scene.FindAllWithComponent("BoxCollider") do
		local collider = entity.BoxCollider
		if collider and not collider.IsTrigger then
			local low, high = Physics.GetColliderBounds(entity)
			if low and high then
				local closest = vector.create(math.clamp(point.x, low.x, high.x), math.clamp(point.y, low.y, high.y), math.clamp(point.z, low.z, high.z))
				local distance = vector.magnitude(closest - point)
				if distance < bestDistance then
					bestDistance = distance
					best = string.format("%s of %s (%.2f m away)", entity.Name, pieceOf(entity), distance)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- The main-path support check: every 0.25 m of the PathNode polyline, starting half a step in, outside every Gap
-- marker, has the Track layer below it.
local function supportCheck(minimumSamples: number)
	local nodes = Scene.FindAllByTag("PathNode")
	table.sort(nodes, byName)
	local points: { vector } = {}
	for index, node in nodes do
		points[index] = node.Transform.WorldPosition
	end
	local markers = Scene.FindAllByTag("Gap")
	local samples, distances = Track.Sample(points, 0.25, 0.125)
	Test.Expect(#samples >= minimumSamples, string.format("%d path samples, at least %d expected", #samples, minimumSamples))
	local mask = Physics.LayerMask("Track")
	local misses = 0
	for index, sample in samples do
		local inGap = false
		for _, marker in markers do
			if Track.InsideBox(marker.Transform:InverseTransformPoint(sample)) then
				inGap = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not inGap and not Physics.Raycast(sample + Lift, Down, 3, mask) then
			misses += 1
			if misses <= 8 then
				Test.Expect(false, string.format("no Track below the path at %.3f m, (%.3f, %.3f, %.3f); nearest: %s", distances[index], sample.x, sample.y, sample.z, nearestPiece(sample)))
			end
		end
	end
	Test.ExpectEqual(misses, 0, "path samples without support")
end

return Test.Suite("RollingBall", function()
	Test.Case("Level 1: the main path is supported everywhere but inside its gaps", function()
		supportCheck(400)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: the HUD shows the level and its par", function()
		expectHud(1)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: a fall respawns the ball at the last checkpoint with no velocity", function()
		local ballEntity, ball, body = ballParts()
		local checkpoint = find("/Level/Checkpoint1")
		local root = checkpoint.Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, root + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.LastOrder == 1
		end, 30)
		local bar = checkpoint:FindChild("Bar") :: Entity
		local graph = checkpoint:GetScript("Checkpoint")
		Test.Expect(graph.Activated == true, "the checkpoint's graph is activated")
		Test.ExpectEqual((bar.MeshRenderer :: MeshRenderer):GetMaterial(1), graph.ActiveMaterial, "the bar shows the active material")
		local timerBefore = game().TotalTicks
		-- Over the void beside the track.
		place(body, root + vector.create(0, 1, 8))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.Respawns == 1
		end, 240)
		local velocity = body:GetLinearVelocity()
		Test.ExpectNear(ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition, root + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0), 0.05, "the ball respawned at the checkpoint")
		Test.Expect(vector.magnitude(velocity) < 0.01, string.format("linear speed %.4f after the respawn", vector.magnitude(velocity)))
		Test.Expect(vector.magnitude(body:GetAngularVelocity()) < 0.01, "no angular velocity after the respawn")
		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Heading, Motion.Wrap(checkpoint.Transform.EulerAngles.y), 0.001, "the heading is the checkpoint's yaw")
		Test.Expect(game().TotalTicks > timerBefore, "the timer kept running")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: rolling back through an earlier checkpoint never moves the spawn backwards", function()
		local ballEntity, ball, body = ballParts()
		local first = find("/Level/Checkpoint1").Transform.WorldPosition
		local second = find("/Level/Checkpoint2")
		local secondRoot = second.Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, secondRoot + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.LastOrder == 2
		end, 30)
		-- Back through Checkpoint1: the ball enters its trigger again and rests inside it.
		local respawns = ball.Respawns
		place(body, first + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(20)
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.LastOrder, 2, "an earlier checkpoint keeps the last order")
		-- Then a fall beside Checkpoint1.
		place(body, first + vector.create(0, 1, 8))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.Respawns == respawns + 1
		end, 240)
		Test.ExpectNear(ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition, secondRoot + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0), 0.05, "the ball respawned at Checkpoint2")
		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Heading, Motion.Wrap(second.Transform.EulerAngles.y), 0.001, "the heading is Checkpoint2's yaw")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: the goal stops the timer and loads Level 2 with it", function()
		local _, ball, body = ballParts()
		local goal = find("/Level/Goal").Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, goal + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.ReachedGoal
		end, 30)
		local current = game()
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.Finished
		end, 5)
		local stopped = current.TotalTicks
		Test.WaitTicks(10)
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, stopped, "the timer stopped")
		Test.Expect(string.sub(hudText("BannerText"), 1, 14) == "LEVEL COMPLETE", "the banner reads LEVEL COMPLETE: " .. hudText("BannerText"))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.LoadRequested
		end, current.LoadDelayTicks + 10)
		Test.Expect(current.Leaving, "the load is the level's one transition")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.SentParameters.ElapsedTicks, stopped, "Level 2 is loaded with the stopped time")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the timer carried across Scene.Load continues", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level2")
		local carried = Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(type(carried) == "number" and carried > 0, "Level 2 was loaded with the elapsed ticks")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.StartTicks, carried, "the game starts from the carried time")
		local before = current.TotalTicks
		Test.WaitTicks(60)
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, before + 60, "the timer counts on")
		Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("TimeText"), Clock.Format(current.TotalTicks), "the HUD shows the run's time")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the HUD shows the level and its par", function()
		expectHud(2)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the lift carries the ball up to the upper deck", function()
		local ballEntity, _, body = ballParts()
		local lift = find("/Level/Lift")
		local platform = lift:GetScript("MovingPlatform") :: PlatformScript.MovingPlatform
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return platform.AtStart and platform.DwellLeft > 45
		end, 700)
		-- The lift's root is its box's centre, 0.25 m below its top: the ball is placed 0.1 m above the top and
		-- measured once it has settled on it.
		place(body, lift.Transform.WorldPosition + vector.create(0, 0.85, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(20)
		local start = ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return platform.AtEnd
		end, 700)
		local finish = ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition
		Test.ExpectNear(finish.y - start.y, 4, 0.1, "the ball rose with the lift")
		local low, high = Physics.GetColliderBounds(lift)
		Test.Expect(low ~= nil and high ~= nil, "the lift has collider bounds")
		if low and high then
			Test.Expect(finish.x >= low.x and finish.x <= high.x and finish.z >= low.z and finish.z <= high.z, "the ball is still on the lift")
		end
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 1200 })

	Test.Case("Level 2: a platform started part-way through its cycle moves on from its phased pose", function()
		local prefab = Assets.Load("Assets/Prefabs/MovingPlatform.prefab")
		Test.Expect(prefab ~= nil, "the MovingPlatform prefab loads")
		if not prefab then
			return
		end
		-- Away from the track and the ball; the authored pose is the cycle's start pose. The phase, halfway up the
		-- rise, is set before the instance's first tick, so that its OnStart reads it.
		local origin = vector.create(0, 20, 40)
		local entity = Scene.Instantiate(prefab, origin)
		local platform = entity:GetScript("MovingPlatform") :: PlatformScript.MovingPlatform
		local body = entity.RigidBody :: RigidBody
		platform.PhaseTicks = platform.DwellTicks + platform.MoveTicks // 2
		local phase = platform.PhaseTicks
		local function ease(tick: number): number
			return Motion.Ease(tick, platform.MoveTicks, platform.DwellTicks)
		end
		for step = 1, 2 do
			Test.WaitTicks(1)
			Test.ExpectEqual(platform.Tick, phase + step, "the platform counts on from its phase")
			local expected = origin + platform.Travel * ease(phase + step)
			Test.ExpectNear(entity.Transform.WorldPosition, expected, 0.001, string.format("the platform's pose %d ticks on from its phase", step))
		end
		-- A Kinematic body's velocity is its last physics step's sweep, and a test case runs before its tick's step:
		-- two ticks after the creation it is the sweep of the platform's first tick. From the phased pose that sweep is
		-- one tick's step; from the authored pose (the platform not placed at its phase) it would be the jump there.
		local perSecond = 1 / Time.GetFixedDeltaTime()
		local travel = vector.magnitude(platform.Travel)
		local stepSpeed = travel * (ease(phase + 1) - ease(phase)) * perSecond
		local jumpSpeed = travel * ease(phase + 1) * perSecond
		local speed = vector.magnitude(body:GetLinearVelocity())
		Test.Expect(speed < 10, string.format("the first tick's sweep moved the platform at %.3f m/s (one tick's step %.3f m/s, the jump from the authored pose %.1f m/s)", speed, stepSpeed, jumpSpeed))
		Scene.Destroy(entity)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the main path is supported everywhere but inside its gaps", function()
		supportCheck(400)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: Restart reloads the level", function()
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(current.Ticks > 60, "the level has run before the restart")
		restart(current)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: the restarted level starts again from the time it was entered with", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level2")
		local carried = Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks
		local current = game()
		local ballEntity, ball = ballParts()
		Test.Expect(type(carried) == "number" and carried > 0, "the reload keeps the elapsed ticks Level 2 was loaded with")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.StartTicks, carried, "the timer starts again from the carried time")
		Test.Expect(current.Ticks < 10, string.format("the level's own time starts again (%d ticks)", current.Ticks))
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, current.StartTicks + current.Ticks, "the run's time is the carried time plus the level's")
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.Respawns, 0, "the ball starts afresh")
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.LastOrder, 0, "no checkpoint is touched")
		Test.ExpectNear(ballEntity.Transform.WorldPosition, ball.Spawn, 0.15, "the ball is back at the level's start")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 2: its next level is Level 3, which the suite loads with a carried time", function()
		local nextLevel = game().NextLevel
		Test.ExpectEqual(nextLevel, Assets.Load("Assets/Scenes/Level3.scene"), "Level 2's next level is Level 3")
		if nextLevel then
			Scene.Load(nextLevel, { ElapsedTicks = 3600 })
		end
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 3: the suite's load arrives with its carried time", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level3")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks, 3600, "Level 3 was loaded with the suite's time")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game().StartTicks, 3600, "the game starts from the carried time")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 3: the HUD shows the level and its par", function()
		expectHud(3)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 3: the main path is supported everywhere but inside its gaps", function()
		supportCheck(500)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 3: the goal shows the finish with the total time", function()
		local _, ball, body = ballParts()
		local goal = find("/Level/Goal").Transform.WorldPosition
		place(body, goal + vector.create(0, 0.6, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.ReachedGoal
		end, 30)
		local current = game()
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return current.Finished
		end, 5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("BannerText"), "FINISHED  " .. Clock.Format(current.TotalTicks) .. "\nPRESS R TO PLAY AGAIN", "the banner shows the run's time")
		Test.WaitTicks(current.LoadDelayTicks + 10)
		Test.Expect(not current.LoadRequested and not current.Leaving, "the last level loads nothing")
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 300 })

	Test.Case("Level 3: Restart after the finish starts a new run", function()
		local current = game()
		Test.Expect(current.Finished, "Level 3 is finished")
		restart(current)
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: the new run starts on Level 1 with no time", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetName(), "Level1")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetLoadParameters().ElapsedTicks, nil, "Level 1 is loaded without a carried time")
		local current = game()
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.StartTicks, 0, "the new run's timer starts at 0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(current.TotalTicks, current.Ticks, "the run's time is Level 1's own")
	end)

	Test.Case("Level 1: a new checkpoint shows the CHECKPOINT banner for BannerTicks ticks", function()
		local _, ball, body = ballParts()
		local current = game()
		local banner = find("/HUD/Banner")
		Test.Expect(not banner:IsActive(), "no banner shows before the checkpoint")
		place(body, find("/Level/Checkpoint1").Transform.WorldPosition + vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return ball.LastOrder == 1
		end, 30)
		-- The ball enters the trigger in a tick's physics step, after that tick's fixed step and this case; the game
		-- sees the new order in the next tick's fixed step and shows the banner there, before this case resumes in that
		-- tick. So the banner shows from the tick in which the case first sees the order.
		local shown = Time.GetTick()
		Test.Expect(banner:IsActive(), "the banner shows in the tick the order rises")
		Test.ExpectEqual(hudText("BannerText"), "CHECKPOINT", "the banner reads CHECKPOINT")
		-- The first tick without the banner, counted from the tick it showed in, is the number of ticks it showed for:
		-- shown in its tick and BannerTicks - 1 more, gone one tick later. With the countdown run after showBanner in the
		-- tick that shows it (S2's order), it would be one fewer.
		Test.WaitUntil(function()
			return not banner:IsActive()
		end, current.BannerTicks + 10)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetTick() - shown, current.BannerTicks, string.format("the banner shown in tick %d shows for BannerTicks ticks", shown))
	end)
end)
